dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curvature following a spline with a deep posterior notch and smooth descent from the apex to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute radius with a rounded shape classification at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior margin measured at approximately 75 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height to maximum base width ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear white scarifications (intraspecific tooth rakes) across the dorsal surface and a small dark circular blemish on the lateral side of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive mottled/marbled epidermal pigmentation pattern throughout the visible dorsal region.
